packs.name: Rainy Window
packs.description: Wistful jazzy lo-fi keys: ii-V-I turns, minor iv colour and soft extended voicings for late-night loops.

packs.name: Late Library
packs.description: Chill study-beat progressions with warm ninths and elevenths that loop for hours without wearing thin.

packs.name: Dust Jacket
packs.description: Dusty boom bap vamps built like a sample flip: minor nine loops, 7#9 turnarounds and stepwise bass lines.

packs.name: Cellar Sessions
packs.description: Darker boom bap changes with chromatic descending bass, Neapolitan colour and tense altered dominants.

packs.name: Velvet Crate
packs.description: Seventies-soul flavoured chord loops made to chop: major sevens into minor iv, secondary dominants and slash walk-downs.

progressions.title: Fogged Glass
progressions.description: A ii-V-I in F with a D7#9 that pulls back to the ii. The inner voices barely move, so it loops like a tape.

progressions.title: Umbrella Line
progressions.description: Two passes of ii-V-I in Db, the second darkened by a b9 and a borrowed Gbm6 at the end. Roll it slow and add vinyl.

progressions.title: Paper Lanterns
progressions.description: i-iv-VII-VI with a 7#9 kick back to the top. The C and E stay on top the whole way so the arp sounds like one melody.

progressions.title: Sleepy Postcard
progressions.description: I-vi-ii-V, then the borrowed Am9 and a iii-ii-V back home. The minor iv in bar six is the bittersweet moment.

progressions.title: Cold Coffee
progressions.description: A ii-V-I into the relative major, then VI and a 7#9 back to iv. Pushed eighths keep it lazy but moving.

progressions.title: Bus Stop Rain
progressions.description: I-IV-iv with the G dropping to Gb, then a quick ii-V home. The classic lo-fi heartbreak move, voiced close.

progressions.title: Window Seat Nap
progressions.description: I-IV-iii-VI7 into ii, a borrowed iv, then a chromatic Em7-Ebdim7-Dm9 slide and a tritone-sub Db9 home.

progressions.title: Lantern Steam
progressions.description: i-iv then a Neapolitan Gmaj7#11 into an altered C#7. The bII is what gives it the late-night tilt.

progressions.title: Moth Light
progressions.description: I into a minor ii-V to vi, then the borrowed Dbm6 and an Eb13 home. Slow and soft, made for a filtered loop.

progressions.title: Static Hymn
progressions.description: A circle-of-fifths walk in B minor that ends on a minor ii-V and a line cliche on the tonic. Arp it and let it breathe.

progressions.title: Radiator Hum
progressions.description: I-VI7-ii-V with a sus dominant that never fully resolves, so the loop floats. The C7#9 adds the grit.

progressions.title: Cardigan Weather
progressions.description: I-vi-ii then a borrowed minor iv6 before the A13. Strum it like a nylon guitar for a wistful hook.

progressions.title: Highlighter Ink
progressions.description: i-VI-iv-V with a b13 on the dominant that sighs back into Cm9. Steady enough to study to.

progressions.title: Margin Notes
progressions.description: I-iii-IV-iv, then a VI7 into ii-V. Two four-bar phrases that answer each other over a soft bass.

progressions.title: Quiet Floor
progressions.description: i-VI-iv and a sus-to-b9 dominant. The G and B hold through the first three chords so the arp stays calm.

progressions.title: Study Lamp
progressions.description: I-vi-IV-V with every chord stretched to a ninth or eleventh. The sus dominant keeps it from ever sounding finished.

progressions.title: Overdue Book
progressions.description: i-VI-iv-V7#9 with C kept on top through the first three chords. Stab it under a swung kick.

progressions.title: Window Draft
progressions.description: i-VI-iv-V in Bb minor, voiced high and open. Leave space for a sampled vocal on top.

progressions.title: Pencil Shavings
progressions.description: i-VI-iv-V twice, the second time swapping the iv for a Neapolitan Dmaj7#11. Same melody note, darker floor.

progressions.title: Library Card
progressions.description: I-vi-ii-V in Gb, all close clusters with a moving inner voice. Very low effort to loop, very hard to get tired of.

progressions.title: Nap Between Classes
progressions.description: i-iv then a bII lydian chord into an altered V. The A stays in the middle the whole time.

progressions.title: Soft Eraser
progressions.description: I-vi-ii-V in B with the eleventh on the ii and a 13 on the V. Rolled slow it sounds like a felt piano.

progressions.title: Index Cards
progressions.description: i-VI-iv-V7#9 in G# minor. The D# rings through the first three chords like a held pedal.

progressions.title: Last Page
progressions.description: i-iv-VII-III, then a minor ii-V and a v that turns major with a #9. Eight bars that loop like one long breath.

progressions.title: Crate Dig Sunday
progressions.description: The same Dm9 over a falling bass D-C-Bb-A, then an altered A7. Chop it into four and the bass does the work.

progressions.title: Dusty Needle
progressions.description: A minor line cliche with the bass stepping down A-G#-G-F#-E. Sounds lifted from an old record before you touch it.

progressions.title: Wax Ring
progressions.description: i-VI-iv-V with the F, G and Bb shared across the first three chords. A tight cluster that sits under a vocal chop.

progressions.title: Chipped Vinyl
progressions.description: i-VI-iv-V, then the bass slides E-F#-F into a b9 turnaround. The Fmaj7#11 is the sour note that makes it dusty.

progressions.title: Basement Echo
progressions.description: i-iv then a Neapolitan Dbmaj7 into a crunchy G7#9. Push it ahead of the beat for a lazy head-nod.

progressions.title: Marker Tags
progressions.description: One Fm9 shape over a bass falling F-Eb-Db-C, finished with a #9 dominant. Classic flip material.

progressions.title: Corner Store Loop
progressions.description: A i-VI-iv-V pass, then a chromatic descent Bb-Ab-G-Gb-F under the same tonic colour. Built to chop into bars.

progressions.title: Rusty Sampler
progressions.description: i-VI-iv-V with low cluster voicings that hit hard as short stabs. Pitch it down for extra dust.

progressions.title: Head Nod Theory
progressions.description: i-iv-VII13-V7#9. The E13 is a borrowed backdoor colour that makes the turnaround feel earned.

progressions.title: Sneaker Scuff
progressions.description: I-IV-iv-V13 in Eb, the minor iv dropping C to Cb for the soul in it. A sunny boom bap loop.

progressions.title: Breakbeat Hymnal
progressions.description: I-VI7-ii then a bVI13 sliding down a half step to a crunchy V. Rolled it sounds like a gospel intro.

progressions.title: Loose Snare
progressions.description: A C#m9 vamp over a stepping bass C#-B-A-G#, closing on a 7#9. Short stabs, swung drums.

progressions.title: Gravel Hymn
progressions.description: A chromatic bass walk D-C#-C-B-Bb under one held shape, then iv, a bII flash and a b9 dominant.

progressions.title: Cold Concrete
progressions.description: i-bII-VI-V, the Neapolitan straight after the tonic. Menacing as short stabs over a hard break.

progressions.title: Iron Stairwell
progressions.description: One m11 shape over a bass falling F#-E-D-C#. Open fourths on top keep it hollow and cold.

progressions.title: Smoke Ledger
progressions.description: The bass walks G-F-E-Eb-D while the top barely moves: a half-diminished and a bVI on the way down to a #9.

progressions.title: Hallway Siren
progressions.description: i-vi half-diminished-bII-V. The Emaj7 is a half step above home and sounds like a siren in the distance.

progressions.title: Brick Dust
progressions.description: i-VI then a minor ii-V with a #9. The B rings through the first two chords as a lydian bite.

progressions.title: Overpass Static
progressions.description: i-VI-iv, then a half-diminished slipping a half step to the Neapolitan Cmaj7 and a #9 V. Ends on a V/3 for the loop.

progressions.title: Pawn Shop Gold
progressions.description: A dorian i-IV9 vamp into VI and a 7#9. The major IV is the bright spot in a dark loop.

progressions.title: Gutter Gospel
progressions.description: i-iv-VII13-VI-V, every chord keeping the C. Rolled, it sounds like a church organ through a dirty sampler.

progressions.title: Pigeon Roof
progressions.description: I-VI7-ii, a borrowed iv6 and a D13 home. A major-key boom bap loop that still feels dusty.

progressions.title: Rain On Tin
progressions.description: One Em11 cluster over a bass falling E-D-C-B, the lydian VI and a #9 turnaround. Arp it slow.

progressions.title: Ashtray Choir
progressions.description: I-vi-iv minor-V7#9 in Ab. The borrowed Dbm9 sinks the loop before the #9 drags it back up.

progressions.title: Satin Ribbon
progressions.description: Major seven into IV, IV turning minor, then iii-VI7-ii-V. The chord rhythm doubles in bar two, like a seventies bridge.

progressions.title: Velour Stairs
progressions.description: I-VI7-ii-V, then iii sliding through a passing Abdim7 to ii. The secondary dominant is what makes it sound like a record.

progressions.title: Cognac Walk
progressions.description: A slash-chord walk-down C-B-A-G-F, then IV to minor iv and a sus V. The bass line is the hook.

progressions.title: Silk Receipt
progressions.description: I-VI7-ii-V, then iii stepping down chromatically to a Db9 and back to ii. Ends sus to b9 for a gospel lift.

progressions.title: Gold Tooth Sunday
progressions.description: A dorian i-IV9 vamp into VI and a 7#9. The major IV is pure seventies soul.

progressions.title: Polyester Prayer
progressions.description: I-VI7#9-ii, then a borrowed minor iv6 before the V13. Slow and sweet, begging to be chopped.

progressions.title: Organ Smoke
progressions.description: I-iii-IV-iv-V13 with the B dropping to Bb in bar four. Play it on an organ patch with a slow swell.

progressions.title: Copper Turnaround
progressions.description: I-III7-vi-II9-V13: two secondary dominants in four bars. Upbeat soul that still has some dirt.

progressions.title: Sunday Hat
progressions.description: I-III7-vi then IV to minor iv. The plagal minor-iv return to E is the warm soul ending.

progressions.title: Wood Panel
progressions.description: I-iii-vi-ii-V, then IV to minor iv and a iii-VI7-ii-V turnaround. Eight bars of classic soul movement.

progressions.title: Mink Morning
progressions.description: A dorian i-IV9 into VI and a dominant that moves from #9 to b9. Smoky and slow.

progressions.title: Lace Curtain
progressions.description: I-III7-vi-II9 then the borrowed minor iv6 back home. Clean-guitar soul at a walking tempo.
